answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 42276 Country: India Title: Iztiba in Tawaf Question: My question is it necessary to do iztiba (keeping right shoulder open in tawaf of Umrah and Hajj) in all 7 rounds of tawaf or it is required in only first rounds of tawaf. Please give me the name of the book in which, it is mentioned that iztiba is done only in the first 3 rounds of tawaf? Answer ID: 42276 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1092/1086/N=1433) (1) Iztiba is sunnah in all the seven rounds of the tawaf after which sa’i is performed not only in the first round or in first three rounds. قال في رد المحتار (كتاب الحج 3:507 ط مكتبة زكريا ديوبند): واعلم أن الاضطباع سنة في جميع أشواط الطواف كما صرح به ابن الضياء ...... قوله: "استنانا" : أي : في كل طواف بعده سعي كطواف القدوم والعمرة وكطوف الزيارة إن كان آخر السعي ولم يكن لابسا اهـ. (2) We do not know any book which mentions iztiba as sunnah in the first three rounds. However ramal (walking while jogging and putting small steps) is sunnah only in the first three rounds after which there is sa’i. So is mentioned in al-Durr Wa al-Radd (Kitab al-Hajj 3:510, 511) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
